description.value:
You launch three small guided explosives at up to three creatures you can see within range, striking simultaneously; you decide whether they converge on one target or spread among several. Each explosive deals 1d4 + 1 fire damage to the creature it hits.

Overcharge Tech. Casting with a slot of 2nd level or higher produces one additional explosive per slot level beyond 1st.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 1
